fix(js-ble): avoid no-response writes on uniapp mini programs

fix(js-ble): avoid no-response writes on uniapp mini programs

Details:
- Default the UniApp BLE adapter to acknowledged writes outside Android app-plus.
- Keep writeNoResponse only for the existing Android app-plus path that needed delayed writes.
- Update the UniApp BLE regression assertion so hardcoded writeNoResponse does not return.

Validation:
- npm --workspace @psdk/device-ble-uniapp test -- --runInBand
- npm --workspace @psdk/device-bluetooth-traits test -- --runInBand
- npm --workspace @psdk/frame-father run build
- npm --workspace @psdk/device-bluetooth-traits run build
- npm --workspace @psdk/device-ble-uniapp run build
